places.name: Geirangerfjord
places.ai_summary: A UNESCO World Heritage site known for its stunning fjord landscapes, waterfalls, and serene beauty.

opening_hours.notes: Accessible year-round, but best in summer.

places.place_tip: Take a boat tour for the best views.

places.name: Seven Sisters Waterfall
places.ai_summary: A majestic waterfall cascading into the Geirangerfjord, offering breathtaking views and a serene atmosphere.

opening_hours.notes: Best viewed from a boat.

places.place_tip: Bring binoculars for a closer look.

places.name: Flydalsjuvet Viewpoint
places.ai_summary: A popular viewpoint offering panoramic views of the Geirangerfjord and surrounding mountains.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in good weather for clear views.

places.place_tip: Visit at sunset for stunning colors over the fjord.

places.name: Dalsnibba Skywalk
places.ai_summary: A mountain plateau with a skywalk offering breathtaking views of the Geirangerfjord and the surrounding mountains.

opening_hours.notes: Road may be closed in winter; check before visiting.

places.place_tip: Dress warmly, it can be windy and cold at the top.

places.name: Eagle Road (Ørnevegen)
places.ai_summary: A scenic drive with stunning views of the Geirangerfjord, featuring hairpin bends and steep cliffs.

opening_hours.notes: Drive carefully, especially in winter conditions.

places.place_tip: Stop at the viewpoints along the road for photos.

places.name: Geiranger Skywalk at Mount Dalsnibba
places.ai_summary: An exhilarating skywalk at Mount Dalsnibba, offering breathtaking views of the Geirangerfjord and the surrounding peaks.

opening_hours.notes: Access may be restricted in winter; check before visiting.

places.place_tip: Combine with a visit to Dalsnibba for a full experience.

places.name: Fjord Cruise
places.ai_summary: A relaxing cruise on the Geirangerfjord, offering stunning views of the fjord, waterfalls, and cliffs.

opening_hours.notes: Advance booking recommended, especially in summer.

places.place_tip: Bring a jacket, it can be chilly on the water.

places.place_tip: Wear sturdy shoes, the trail can be slippery.

places.ai_summary: A popular viewpoint offering stunning views of the Geirangerfjord, known for its eagle-shaped bend in the road.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in good weather for clear views.

places.place_tip: Visit during sunset for a magical experience.

places.name: Skageflå Farm Hike
places.ai_summary: A hiking trail leading to the abandoned Skageflå farm, offering stunning views of the Geirangerfjord.

opening_hours.notes: Best in summer; trail may be closed in winter.

places.place_tip: Bring water and snacks, no facilities on the trail.

places.place_tip: Stop at the viewpoints for photos.

places.name: Geiranger Church
places.ai_summary: A historic church in Geiranger, known for its beautiful architecture and serene surroundings.

opening_hours.notes: Closed from November to April.

places.place_tip: Respect the quiet atmosphere, it's a place of worship.
